images.title: 正面 · 朝屏幕飞来
images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE isolated transparent-background pixel-art RPG game sprite of Elaina riding a broom, as a NEW directional view matching the supplied right-facing pixel sprite. Image 1 is the character, costume, proportions, palette and pixel-style reference, not a layout to repeat. Keep the same large chibi head, SILVER WHITE long hair, purple eyes when visible, very wide black-purple pointed hat with pale pink bands and small gold ornament, black-purple cloak with burgundy lining, white blouse, gold neck ribbon, short dark skirt and dark boots. Match the same coarse retro pixel art, large square pixel clusters, dark stair-step outline, flat restricted palette and simple highlights. Not a smooth illustration, no blur or antialiased rendering, no tiny new details. A slightly elevated camera appropriate for a top-down RPG, NOT an aerial overhead view. Full body and the complete broom inside a 4:3 landscape transparent canvas, sprite centered with a little clear margin; match the reference's character height and head size, designed to remain readable at 64 by 48 screen pixels. One riding pose only, no sprite sheet, no ground or scenery, no painted checkerboard, no shadow, no text, no labels, no border. Actual transparent alpha. IMPORTANT DIRECTION: FRONT view facing the viewer, travelling toward the BOTTOM of the game screen. We see her complete face and both purple eyes, front of the blouse and cloak. Do not return a side-facing pose. The brim is wide and foreshortened; face remains unobscured. She is clearly seated sideways on the broom rather than standing: thighs and knees bent together, boots hanging together toward the viewer's right, skirt covers the lap, one hand gripping the wooden shaft near her hip. The broom runs in DEPTH, its forward handle projects toward the bottom foreground beneath her, its rear straw brush sits behind her toward the upper background and may peek out beside the cloak. Shorten the visible shaft through perspective, do NOT rotate the reference horizontal broom in the picture plane. Calm friendly expression. Hair falls behind her shoulders and cloak flows behind. Preserve the exact reference costume and silver-white hair.
